request: Plan our video for the next quarter. We want more sign-ups from salon, clinic and studio owners. Two of us make video, about 16 hours a week together including editing. Which networks, how often, and what do we film?
business: Example Booking Software, an online booking and scheduling app for small service businesses (invented example)
product: online booking, reminders and payments for salons, clinics, studios and personal trainers
audience: owners and front-desk managers of small service businesses with 1 to 20 staff, mostly in the US, UK and Canada

answers.on_camera: the head of marketing, plus two customers who agreed to appear
